title: Resolution granting tax break for Fordham Bedford Cluster, Bronx
summary: The resolution approves a property tax exemption for an affordable housing project at Block 3304, Lot 156 and Block 3324, Lot 99 in the Bronx, known as Fordham Bedford Cluster Phase I, owned by a housing development fund company. The exemption runs for up to 40 years from June 25, 2021 and depends on compliance with an affordable housing regulatory agreement with the city's Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
